svc_video_about_p1: Video surveillance is the most effective way to monitor your property and deter crime. We design and install CCTV systems in Riga and across Latvia — for apartments, private houses, offices and businesses.
svc_video_about_p2: We work with proven equipment from leading manufacturers: high-resolution IP cameras (2–8 MP), night vision, motion detection and remote viewing from your phone anywhere in the world.
svc_video_f3: Remote monitoring from phone or computer
svc_access_about_p1: Effective access management is the foundation of security and order. Access control systems let you precisely regulate who may enter, when and where. They are essential for offices, warehouses, apartment buildings and any property where security matters.
svc_access_about_p2: We design and install access control systems in Riga and across Latvia: intercoms and video door phones, keypads, card and fob readers, biometric fingerprint readers, electric and electromagnetic locks, and turnstiles.
svc_smart_about_p1: Smart locks are the future — today. Open doors with your phone, a code or a card, no traditional keys needed. Perfect for Airbnb, offices and modern apartments.
svc_smart_about_p2: We are official Tedee partners in Latvia. We also install and configure Yale, Nuki and other brands.
svc_smart_f2: Access by phone, code or card
svc_safe_about_p1: We offer a wide range of safes for every purpose — from compact home models to burglar-resistant and fireproof safes for business. We will help you choose a safe that meets your requirements for security, capacity and functionality.
svc_safe_about_p2: We not only sell safes but also install them professionally in Riga and across Latvia — with secure anchoring and maximum concealment. A properly installed safe significantly increases the protection of your valuables.
svc_fire_about_p1: Ensure round-the-clock protection of your property with a modern security alarm. We offer complete security system installation in Riga and across Latvia, protecting effectively against both unauthorised entry and fire.
svc_fire_about_p2: AJAX is the undisputed market leader in wireless systems — innovative technology delivers instant alerts and outstanding reliability. We also professionally install wired and wireless systems from the world-renowned brands PARADOX and DSC. Our specialists will configure the optimal setup for your property.
svc_fire_f1: AJAX wireless systems — instant alerts to your phone
svc_fire_f2: Wired and wireless PARADOX and DSC systems
svc_fire_f3: Motion, entry, smoke and heat detectors
svc_doors_about_p1: Metal entrance doors are the first line of defence for your home or business. Modern metal doors are not only secure but also aesthetically pleasing.
svc_doors_about_p2: We supply and install metal doors with certified locks, additional protection layers and a choice of finish options.
svc_doors_f1: Steel doors with certified strength rating
svc_doors_f5: Installation and removal of old doors
svc_locks_about_p1: A reliable lock is the foundation of your home or office security. We specialise in professional lock replacement and installation in Riga and across Latvia, offering only proven solutions from the world's leading manufacturers — ASSA, ABLOY, ABUS, MOTTURA, TESA, WILKA, CISA and YALE.
svc_locks_about_p2: Every lock installed by our specialists guarantees durability and a high level of burglary protection. We select the optimal solution for your needs and budget — from high-security cylinder locks to smart locks with phone, code or fingerprint access.
svc_locks_f1: High-security cylinders (class A, B, C) and multi-point systems
svc_locks_f2: Smart locks: Tedee GO2, PRO, Yale and Nuki
svc_locks_f3: Access by phone, code, card or fingerprint
svc_locks_f4: Key cutting, duplicates and code reprogramming

d_faq_q1: How much does a metal door cost in Riga?
d_faq_a1: Our metal door prices start from 520 € (STANDART model) and go up to 750 € (SKANDI INOX PLUSS model). All prices are excl. VAT (21%) and include delivery and installation within Riga.
d_faq_q2: Is installation included in the price?
d_faq_a2: Yes, delivery and professional installation are included in the stated price for Riga clients. For Jūrmala, Jelgava and Ogre — please enquire about delivery costs when ordering.
d_faq_q3: Which lock is the most reliable?
d_faq_a3: The most reliable option is MOTTURA series 52 locks, fitted in the PREMIUM and SKANDI INOX PLUSS models. These are professional locks with enhanced break-in protection. For maximum security we recommend SKANDI INOX PLUSS with two MOTTURA 52 locks.
d_faq_q4: How long does manufacturing and installation take?
d_faq_a4: Please enquire about lead times when ordering — they depend on production capacity. Door installation itself takes a few hours. We agree a time convenient for you.
d_faq_q5: Can I order a non-standard size?
d_faq_a5: Standard maximum size is 960×2060 mm. For non-standard openings, contact us — we manufacture doors to individual dimensions. Double doors (DIVVIRU) are quoted individually.
d_faq_q6: What is the warranty on the doors?
d_faq_a6: We provide an official 2-year warranty on all work and materials. Service is available in Riga, Jūrmala, Jelgava and Ogre.
d_faq_q7: What makes your doors different from cheap alternatives?
d_faq_a7: We do not manufacture economy-grade doors. We use steel 1.5–2.0 mm thick (budget doors are often 0.8–1 mm), only quality MOTTURA and ASSA locks, mineral wool filling. Our doors are heavier and more reliable — you can feel the difference immediately.

svc_locks_about_p3: We are official Tedee partners in Latvia. We install, program and service Tedee, Yale, Nuki and Mottura equipment, cut keys and provide 24/7 emergency door opening without damage. Trust the professionals — choose reliability and quality!
svc_locks_f6: ASSA, ABLOY, ABUS, MOTTURA, TESA, WILKA, CISA, YALE locks
svc_safe_about_p3: We also help in emergencies: we open forgotten or faulty safes without damage whenever possible. Invest in the safety of your property — choose our safes and professional installation.
svc_fire_about_p3: Fire safety is not a luxury but a necessity. We install fire alarm systems of any complexity — from simple conventional systems to addressable solutions that pinpoint the exact location of a fire. We work with the proven brands Teletek, INIM and Bentel, and also offer certified AJAX fire solutions that integrate with your security system into unified protection compliant with all fire safety norms and standards.
svc_video_about_p3: Every project is individual: we determine the number and placement of cameras, configure NVR/DVR or cloud recording and train you to use the system. Try our online CCTV planner — place cameras on your floor plan right in the browser.
svc_access_about_p3: We take an individual approach to every client — building a system that matches your needs and the scale of your property: from a single door to a complete building-wide solution. You get full control over staff and visitor movement, an access log, working-time tracking and streamlined processes.
